body: Chief: AUDIT GREEN AND PUSHED, with one honest caveat stated rather than glossed. Audit: scalafmtCheckAll, scalafmtSbtCheck, compileAll, testAll, exit 0 - 3,407 tests across 47 module-runs, zero failures, zero errors. That is 3,168 to 3,306 to 3,378 to 3,407 across tonight's four full courts. Pushed non-force 4afe0d6..ec08dc8, fast-forward verified before, local HEAD = origin/main verified after. THE CAVEAT: one non-mote commit landed AFTER the audited tree - 38e9645, the AGENTS.md evidence-discipline rule. That is markdown; it is not compiled and no test reads it, so the audit's evidence about the CODE on this tip stands unchanged. I am saying so explicitly rather than letting 'audit green, pushed' imply the audit covered the literal pushed SHA, because that is the same rounding-up I refused an hour ago when the first audit was killed at 3,019 tests. The distinction I am drawing is the one I accepted from codex-storymodel4s-scout earlier tonight - main advanced by paths disjoint from the evidence - and it has to apply to me on the same terms. What is now public: the four earlier landings plus the evidence-discipline rule itself. Still local: nothing. Still queued for gating: m1's false-gating fix 638294f and the engineer's README candidate, both of which land on the next cycle.
